bullet_points: DEVELOPED WITH TEACHING EXPERTS - For early beginners ages 3-8. The Spot Color Immersion Method weaves foundational vocabulary into first readers with simple text, repetition, visual cues, humor and more. Includes 100 theme words and 50+ high-frequency words and expressions.

ONLINE AUDIO - Access the online audio narration by a native speaker from any mobile phone, tablet, or computer (adults don’t need to help with pronunciation).

products.description:
Spanish for Kids Set 1 is a motivating set of first little Spanish books for kids ages 3-8 who are beginning to learn Spanish. Developed with teachers, the unique Spot Color Immersion Method combines picture cues, simple sentences, repetition, humor and context in just one line of text per page to help beginners learn basic concepts faster. Children proudly finish reading their first book, then all 10, an accomplishment that builds confidence and motivates them to continue learning Spanish. Kids learn the correct pronunciation listening to the online audio narration by a native speaker. Set 1 features:
  • 10 easy Spanish readers, each 16 pages
  • One line of Spanish text per page with a repetition structure
  • Access to the online audio narration using the web address/URL in the books (stream online or download the MP3)
  • English translation at the back
  • Bilingual Spanish-English word chart on the inside cover
  • 32 Activity Sheets (downloadable pdf) for fun practice

The 10 books: Family, Animals, Clothing, Colors, Face/Body, Fruit, Numbers, Shapes, Snacks and Toys. The vocabulary choice was reviewed by teachers/editors.

Why parents and teachers love Language Together®:
  • AWARD-WINNING READERS. Children lose interest in workbooks and flash cards with no context but learn naturally with stories. Beautifully illustrated by Geisel Honor winner Nancy Meyers.
  • CONFIDENCE-BUILDER. Kids proudly say, “I read these little stories on my own–in Spanish!” A fun, non-intimidating way to begin Spanish learning for kids in preschool, pre-k, kindergarten and early elementary. Toddlers can listen/look.
  • SUPPORTS DIFFERENT LEARNING STYLES. Visual and auditory learners easily learn words reinforced by picture cues and audio.
  • TEACHES CRITICAL LANGUAGE SKILLS. Complements any school or homeschool curriculum for Spanish learning for kids ages 3-8.
More: Spanish for Kids Set 2

products.description:
Hypothyroidism and Your Thyroid: Hypothyroidism Remedies to Help You Select a Healthy Diet, Permanently Lose Weight, Boost Energy Levels, and Feel Amazing Free from Hypothyroidism

A simple explanation of hypothyroidism is a low secretion of thyroid hormones throughout the body.

It is believed that a substantial portion of the population is mildly to severely impacted by hypothyroidism. Often these people affected by hypothyroidism go undiagnosed or are misdiagnosed and do not receive proper treatment .

Those affected by hypothyroidism can find the disease very difficult to deal with, as it can significantly impact their day to day life negatively. The symptoms of hypothyroidism can vary from person to person but some of the common symptoms include fatigue, depression, constipation, muscular weakness, stiffness, pain and swelling in joints, irregular menstrual cycles, difficulty sleeping and difficulty waking up feeling refreshed, unexplained weight gain and difficulty losing weight.

products.description:
A horse race in trousers on Rotten Row. Visiting a gaming hall in a dress that would make her mother faint. Sneaking an invitation to a masquerade ball attended by only the wickedest, most debauched members of society…

None of these things are scaring off bookish but strong-willed Amelia Bishop’s stuffy, egotistical fiancé.

The only thing left is to entice childhood friend Nicholas Wakefield into a truly engagement-ending scandal. The Wakefields are the height of propriety, and Nicholas’s parents have made it clear a wife from the neighboring Bishop family would be unacceptable…

But Nicholas would give up his family and his fortune if Amelia would ever see him as more than just a childhood friend. He’ll go along with her scheme, even if it means ruining them both, because he’s got a plan that will change her mind about him being merely the boy next door.

products.title: Carcassonne Safari Board Game | Family Board Game | Board Game for Adults and Family | Strategy Board Game | Adventure Board Game | Ages 8 and up | 2-5 Players | Made by Z-Man Games
bullet_points: STRATEGY GAME: Explore the Savanna as Africa swelters under the blazing sun in this exciting stand-alone game inspired by the classic Carcassonne which provides plenty of ways to use your cunning and outsmart your opponents.

EXPLORE THE AFRICAN SAVANNA: Brave the sweltering sun and join the safari group to explore the plains and spot the many wondrous animals that live there. Climb the baobab tree to get a birds-eye view, walk the trails and spot the animals hiding in the bush, blaze new trails with the ranger vehicles, and dig watering holes where wildlife can peacefully gather.

OBSERVE WILD ANIMALS: On your journey across the plains, you’ll discover many different animals. Monkeys swing in the trees, lions repose in the shade, and the ground shakes under the thunderous footfalls of elephants. While animals one and all gather at the watering holes; trek out into the bush, lie in wait, and see the majesty of nature unfold.

HOW TO ACHIEVE VICTORY: Just like in Carcassonne, you have the option to place meeple on features as you discover them and score points once they’re completed. But with Carcassonne Safari, variety is key. Keep a keen eye as you continue your exploration. Whoever spots the most animals will amass the most points and be declared the winner!

HIGH REPLAYABILITY: With its simple yet rich game mechanics offering numerous combinations, Carcassonne Safari appeals to beginners and veteran gamers alike. LOOKING FOR NEW ADVENTURES? Try our other Standalone Carcassonne Board Games. Average Playtime: 35 minutes.

Allkeys 50ft Garden Hose Expandable Water Hose with 8 Function Nozzle, Leakproof Lightweight Expanding Garden Water Hose with three quarter inch Solid Brass Connectors,
Extra Strength 3750D Durable Gardening Outdoor Hose Pipe for Watering and Washing

Specifications:
Hose Length: 100 Feet
Inner Hose: 3 layer latexs
Connector Material: Solid brass
Diameter of the valve: Three quarter inch
Working Temperature: Optimum 41℉-113℉
8 Pattern Nozzle: CENTRE, MIST, SHOWER, FLOOD, FLAT, FULL, CONE, JET

Benefits:
1. Compact, lightweight, easy to carry and store
2. Expands quickly to 3 times in length
3. standard three quarter inch brass connector, works with any standard faucet in the US
4. eight pattern hose nozzle meets your watering needs
5. Drains water in seconds by contracting automatically
6. No bursts, no leaks or cracks
7. No kinks, no tangles

Package Include:
1 Expandable Garden Hose 100ft
1 Spray Nozzle (8 Patterns Selectable)
1 Hanging Hook
1 Storage Bag
1 Plumbers Thread Tape
3 Rubber Washers
1 User Manual

Notice:
1.Make sure that the water pressure is in the normal range between 3 and 10 bar ( between 43 and 145PSI) to make the hose extend to 100ft.
2.Suitable working under water pressure range between 0.2 and 0.6MPa.
3.Don’t recommend to use the expandable water hose on garden hose reel.
4.Drain the water from the expandable garden hose and hang it up when not in use, or store it in the bag.
5.Do not expose the portable garden hose to high temperature or low temperature for a long time.
